title: 第13章 契约失败排排死第14章 第三夜首位访客
slug: 虚实梦境之主从死后开始
content_zh:
孟天本人是厉鬼，死亡空间就是鬼域，就是厉鬼的力量衍生，最受阳光阳刚力量克制。
此时，死亡空间突然多出一轮大日，自然动荡不已，万事万物都被大日灼烧的扭曲，甚至发挥不出来原来力量的十分之一。
不过…
孟天站在办公室窗前，感受着难耐的灼热温度，看着那轮耀眼炽热的大日，眼中却是闪过一抹火热。
他的力量虽然在被燃烧，但却变得更为纯净。
原来还是驳杂的阴邪怨气融合灵魂之力所化的鬼气，如今却是显出了几分堂皇正大。
更偏向传说中的幽冥地府阴神神力，而非是普通的冤魂厉鬼。
感受到自身变化之后，他看向天空太阳的目光，似乎比那太阳都还要更为炽热了。
他现在只能留下这么一团“太阳真火”，并且还会对死亡空间造成莫大的影响。
但是，随着实力提升，他未必不能将其同化，生成属于死亡空间的太阳。
到时候，死亡空间也许将和现实无异，而他本人更是可能化作那传说中的阳神，乃至重入现实世界。
孟天抬手，虚虚一握，似要将那太阳抓在手中。
与此同时，死亡空间的力量被其调动，汇聚那轮明亮的太阳周围，尝试着对其能量进行同化。
虽然几乎看不出效果，但孟天却是乐此不彼。
回到办公桌坐下，孟天再次分出一具分身，前往世界之外。
离开世界之后，孟天只觉得温度库库上涨，仿佛又要融化了一般。
不过，身后的死亡空间，却在此时传来一股清凉的气息，使得他的身体得以稳定，就是依旧感觉酷热难耐就是了。
放眼打量梦境虚空，一片赤红泛金，没有半个星点存在。
这表明，周围虚空并没有梦境空间。
想想也是，如今大概还是白天，有多少人会在这个时候睡觉？

至少如今的死亡空间周围，并没有睡觉之人。
眼见如此，孟天只能失望的重新回到死亡空间，看着他的另一具分身不断重复死亡过程。
他的能量，也在这个过程之中快速恢复。
只可惜，天空还有个大日焚烧，恢复甚至不及消耗的多。
不过也不是没有任何好处，那就是死亡空间的能量依旧在被提纯，变得越来越精纯，越来越坚韧。
给他的感觉，似乎将要完成大的蜕变，达到b级了一般。
然而事实上，他如今只有c2级别，本身能量更是只有18点，距离c3都还有很大一段距离呢。
除了能量的恢复之外，随着孟天分身的一次次死亡，死亡规则也在一点点的增强。
感受到这些，孟天不禁将注意力回到办公室，感应着那一道员工契约雏形。
它是不是也能增强？又该通过什么方式增强？招聘员工吗？
可是…
如今的死亡空间，就他一人而已。
“嗯…”
孟天捏着下巴沉思，如果把分身算作员工行不行？
content_en:
Meng Tian himself is a ghost, and the dead space is the ghost realm, which is derived from the power of the ghost and is most restrained by the masculine power of the sun.
At this time, a big sun suddenly appeared in the dead space, and it was naturally turbulent. Everything was distorted by the sun, and it could not even exert one tenth of its original power.
But…
Meng Tian stood in front of the office window, feeling the unbearable scorching temperature. Looking at the dazzling and blazing sun, there was a flash of fire in his eyes.
Although his power was burning, it became purer.
The ghostly aura that was originally a mixture of evil, evil and resentful energy fused with the power of the soul, now appears to be somewhat dignified.
He prefers the legendary power of the underworld gods rather than ordinary ghosts.
After feeling his own changes, his gaze towards the sun in the sky seemed to be even hotter than that sun.
He can only leave this "True Sun Fire" behind now, and it will also have a huge impact on the dead space.
However, as his strength increases, he may not be able to assimilate it and generate a sun belonging to the dead space.
By then, the dead space may be no different from reality, and he himself may even transform into the legendary Yang God, and even re-enter the real world.
Meng Tian raised his hand and shook it weakly, as if he wanted to catch the sun in his hand.
At the same time, the power of the dead space was mobilized and gathered around the bright sun, trying to assimilate its energy.
Although there was almost no visible effect, Meng Tian was happy with it.
After returning to his desk and sitting down, Meng Tian once again created a clone and headed outside the world.
After leaving this world, Meng Tian only felt that the temperature was rising, as if he was about to melt again.
However, a cool breath came from the dead space behind him at this time, which stabilized his body, but it still felt unbearably hot.
Looking at the void of the dreamland, it was a red and golden field, without even a single star.
This shows that there is no dream space in the surrounding void.
Think about it, it's probably still daytime now, how many people will be sleeping at this time?
At least there are no sleeping people around the dead space now.
Seeing this, Meng Tian could only return to the death space in despair, watching his other clone repeat the death process.
His energy also recovered quickly during this process.
Unfortunately, there is still a big sun burning in the sky, and the recovery is not even as much as the consumption.
But it's not without any benefits, that is, the energy of dead space is still being purified, becoming more and more pure and tough.
It gave him the feeling that he was about to complete a major transformation and reach B level.
However, in fact, he is only at C2 level now, and his energy is only 18 points, which is still a long way from C3.
In addition to the recovery of energy, as Meng Tian's clones died again and again, the rules of death were also strengthened little by little.
Feeling this, Meng Tian couldn't help but return his attention to the office, feeling the prototype of the employee contract.
Can it also be enhanced? How should it be enhanced? Recruiting staff?
But...
He is the only one in the dead space now.
"Well..."
Meng Tian held his chin and pondered, would it be okay if the clones were counted as employees?
